resources.string: Optional TV apps · MiracastReceiver (casting) and HGTV (short dramas) are separate third-party applications. Nothing is downloaded or installed until you select Install. Installed apps appear in your app grid and can be placed in the Dock. Automatic updates apply only to apps already installed.
